Delhi Police Files FIR Against Congress MP Bimol Akoijam for Sexual Harassment

The Delhi Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) naming Congress Member of Parliament Bimol Akoijam in connection with sexual harassment allegations. The FIR was filed following a complaint against the MP, who is also identified as a JNU professor.
